identification_key: Read in the main session from frames cut with ffmpeg from yt-dlp downloads (evidence/r2026-10-10/14-global/frames/<videoId>-<mmss>.jpg) and from the watch digests (evidence/r2026-10-10/14-global/yt/yt-<videoId>.txt). Cookies named by element icon + art as in evidence/r2026-10-09/08-extract/dc-2.json and dc-3.json: light shooter brown hair purple eye = 브시커; fire shooter red hair = 전갈; light gold = 치케; water yellow face purple headphones = 피겨; light nurse with leader banner = 우유; dark black/red hair = 닼초; grass pale lilac/green hair = 샤르도네; dark grey hair monocle = 피노; dark red curls = 석류; grass teal hair orange flower = 정전; light pink fluffy hair, shield icon = 딸크 (the subtitles name 딸크); light white-bearded knight = 실론. Star counts are not transcribed: the frames are too small to separate pink from gold on every card. Only the two Korean conquest guides were downloaded; the other conquest videos in the round's searches are summarised from their watch digests alone.

posts.summary_en: 서신우 runs the Chardonnay deck with Strawberry Crepe (Lv.83) in Melon Soda's slot and Scorpion at Lv.64, at 4.54G team power. His run ends at 3,136,690,367,977 (3T 136G, ≈691배 derived). Pinot and Tiger Lily sit at Lv.1, Dark Choco at Lv.50, the six recipients and Pomegranate at Lv.118. The subtitle gives the ATK order 우유, 시커, 피겨, 실론, 치즈, 전갈, 딸크. Chardonnay's rune page shows four open lines, all skill amp (3.20–4.70%), with the ★8 and ★10 lines still locked.
